hook.text: You see 300 posts daily from thousands available. Why those 300? No platform fully explains.

buildup.text: Transparency means letting users see and understand why content appears in their feed.

discovery.text: Twitter open-sourced its algorithm in 2023. Researchers found it boosted political content unevenly.

twist.text: Knowing how it works didn't change behavior. Users continued scrolling the same way.

climax.text: Critics say transparency is theater. The real power is in the optimization target, not the code.

punchline.text: Seeing the cage doesn't open the door.

quiz.question: What happened when Twitter open-sourced its algorithm?
